title: How to "DELETE" Leads through the API using Zapier
text:
## How to "DELETE" Leads through the API using Zapier
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102581
This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to delete a lead on a site using the site's API.

## Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example
1) Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created:
How To Generate an API Key
2) Make sure to have a Google Spreadsheet ready. This spreadsheet should have at least one row of the lead information shown below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153439196/original/07EqcDPnuYqBngVbiQ5TMppwa9mnGTcj7A.png?1733244181 | alt: ]
Please note the following required fields in order to delete a member lead:
lead_id
lead_email to identify the emails that submitted the lead being deleted
Find the ID of the Lead in Interactions » Member Leads :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153437856/original/-C1CgIPsMl97OflzCM1QKTmHoQDEhi30pw.png?1733243117 | alt: ]

## Connecting Google Sheets with Zapier
Log in to the Zapier account and click on + Create and click on Zaps :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149715372/original/IFqb_2Gl6MSr_sn5mI8HOeluIAr3VGauCw.png?1726762728 | alt: ]
or Click on Zaps
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149715300/original/w6uczFGeMLRqpd9dBmGzkuo4FPYSoeS7KA.png?1726762649 | alt: ]
Click on + Create then click on New Zap:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149715295/original/0ksTQIwl9I_Es1ztkoa3hG6U8dG_ezaQDw.png?1726762630 | alt: ]
Click on Trigger and search for Google Sheet:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149196948/original/nZZXjY2yCyB6EscuKzQTJCn7s43jpjdV1g.gif?1725922583 | alt: ]
The Trigger event should be set to "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row." After logging into the Google account, clicking on "Continue" will proceed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149715953/original/RMLfdTyU45RSX8GLR1r5vEuiygt6psSKoQ.png?1726763377 | alt: ]
Select the Spreadsheet that has the lead information with the respective Worksheet. If necessary, select a Trigger Column or leave as "any column" and click on Continue:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438030/original/KOIfFY89lRixpYlDHlkzpeck5VdSOsEr6A.png?1733243264 | alt: ]
Click on Continue with Selected Record. The Spreadsheet information will display as a preview:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438102/original/MvC01ahURxdWBNOWOXVzQDWehN1W1nRcFw.png?1733243296 | alt: ]

## Connecting the API with Zapier
A new set of options will appear, select the option for Brilliant Directories:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149197936/original/HbY9BUDAxqa5-u31-Gp34W4D-MEdmwtmXg.gif?1725924212 | alt: ]
The Action Event should be set to "Delete Lead." A Brilliant Directories account can be chosen if one has been used before, or a new account can be connected.
If an account is already, skip down to FILL IN THE BLANK.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438288/original/MhqSfOTFfvcZR62Kp_Zb966aJ_z96aE7Eg.png?1733243505 | alt: ]
If this is the first time, click on Connect a new account and a popup will show up. Add the website URL and the API Key , and click Yes, Continue to Brilliant Directories:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438569/original/oNzPRGS9c-c_8crJeSbfTYoo3xbxqoZNjA.png?1733243673 | alt: ]
Once finished, click Continue.

## Configuring the Lead Information
Click on Continue.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153439152/original/Y1QU_-iIukSMw76uW0vh-isv020R-IT8hQ.png?1733244138 | alt: ]
Click on the vertical dots and select Custom.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438674/original/KIlD1Ut3Y3yaimYiesNGfTyS9Q1KCHHRCg.png?1733243720 | alt: ]
Select lead_id. Hit Continue.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438725/original/TLqPN4UaL1CF68byzTATt6RQlFGVsJ66YA.png?1733243770 | alt: ]
Click on Test Step:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438735/original/oVyi0Qdg21NuT1kTGoReXnkU47NIkVieLw.png?1733243793 | alt: ]
The record is now deleted, click on Publish to have the Zap active.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438755/original/qa-YVR-w9Rv2mvSlTbAVhCdMy5L-bHIFxg.png?1733243826 | alt: ]
Add a name to the Zap to find it easily:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438835/original/bBPd-KgTzECOLoTESw4d1j8Q4R_OEQz3-Q.png?1733243897 | alt: ]
If done correctly, the lead will be removed in the Interactions » Member Leads page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12153438853/original/g8_qoODQHy-19ax-a5O1OY8qXdHZ4RClhg.png?1733243929 | alt: ]
Click on Transfer existing data is there is a need to delete the leads right away. For automatic deletion, simply waiting a few minutes for the trigger "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row" to take action is all that's needed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12149720915/original/g0L337R9nxxuHQJgrXrN-9gqc6-XwghjmQ.png?1726769130 | alt: ]
